main_text.p: mercati, aliorūqș cōmentarij in Ari- stotelē legūt? Et ut ad Ciceronē ue- niamus, cur in hasce Oratorias par- titiones (ut alia eius omittā opera) post Georgiū Vallā, & Strebæū, La- tomus, Sturmius, Hegēdorphinus, Melanthon, Camerarius, Vitus A- merpachius, suas cogitationes sen- saqș protulerūt? Certe eadē causę fe- rē (quas honestas fuisse nō dubito) quæ illos, nos etiā ad scribendū ex- citarūt. Explicādę nobis fuerūt Ora- toriæ partitiones: dum cura & cogi- tatione in hoc munus incumbimus, alia ex aliis, ut fit, in mentē uenerūt, neqș enim erant à nobis aliorū com- mentarij tantū recitandi, sed nostr nobis genius sequendus: ex eis, quā- tum quoqș modo uidebatur, sumen- dum: alia probanda, alia reijcienda, alia corrigenda, explicanda, confir- māda, differēda, atqș in certū ordinē digerēda: afferenda etiam noua for- tassis aliqua: & ex ijsdem fontibus, e quib. ipse hauserat Cicero, hauriēda: atqș

page.notes: Running head is set in small capitals; the page number "4" and the catchword "atqș" stand at the foot. Two marginal ink marks and a faint show-through from the reverse page are not transcribed. The first word "mercati" is partly obscured at the left edge and is read with [?] where uncertain: "mercati" is clear. The signature mark "œ" at the foot is read as a gathering mark and may be a [?] reading.
